brief: Stone Gothic Revival Catholic church of 1859: a steep gable-front nave of coursed rubble stone with corner buttresses capped by small pinnacles, lancet side windows, and a square central entrance tower projecting from the facade with a pointed-arch door, tall lancet window and an octagonal wooden belfry lantern topped by a thin cross mast. HABS drawings record the plan and elevations.

facade.notes: Immaculate Conception (Burlington WI, 1859), HABS (winter): a coursed-rubble Gothic Revival church -- steep gable front with corner buttresses and pinnacles, a square central tower engaged in the gable with a tall lancet, a statue niche and a gabled pointed portal, an octagonal wooden belfry cap with a spire pole; side lancets; a snowy street with utility poles

why.note: the central-tower Gothic front: the standard immigrant Catholic parish church of the 1850s-70s
